entries.description: Gives a chance to block enemy melee and ranged attacks.

entries.description: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.

entries.name: Parry
entries.description: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

entries.name: Languages
entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Battle Stance
entries.description: A balanced combat stance.

entries.name: Charge
entries.description: Charge an enemy, generate 15 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

entries.name: Hamstring
entries.description: Maims the enemy, causing 45 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 50% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Heroic Strike
entries.description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 157 and causes a high amount of threat.

entries.name: Mocking Blow
entries.description: A mocking attack that causes 93 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

entries.name: Mortal Strike
entries.description: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 160 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

entries.name: Overpower
entries.description: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 35. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

entries.name: Rend
entries.description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

entries.name: Retaliation
entries.description: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

entries.name: Spearing Strike
entries.description: A brutal attack that deals 75% weapon damage. Deals an additional 75% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

entries.name: Sweeping Strikes
entries.description: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

entries.name: Tactical Mastery
entries.description: You retain up to 10 Rage when you change Stances.

entries.name: Thunder Clap
entries.description: Blasts nearby enemies with thunder, increasing the time between their attacks by 20% for 30 sec and doing 103 damage to them. Will affect up to 4 targets.

entries.name: Victory Rush
entries.description: Instantly attack the target causing 15% of Attack Power damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health. Only useable within 20 sec after you kill a non-trivial enemy.

entries.name: Battle Shout
entries.description: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 20 yards by 139. Lasts 3 min.

entries.name: Berserker Rage
entries.description: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

entries.name: Berserker Stance
entries.description: An aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries.description: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 48 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

entries.name: Challenging Shout
entries.description: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

entries.name: Cleave
entries.description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 50 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

entries.name: Death Wish
entries.description: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Demoralizing Shout
entries.description: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 204 for 45 sec.

entries.name: Execute
entries.description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 600 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 15 additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

entries.name: Intercept
entries.description: Charge an enemy, causing 65 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

entries.name: Intimidating Shout
entries.description: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 enemies within 8 yds will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.

entries.name: Piercing Howl
entries.description: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Pummel
entries.description: Pummel the target for 50 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

entries.name: Reckless Swings
entries.description: Your next 4 melee attacks generate 5 additional Rage. Lasts 8 sec.

entries.name: Recklessness
entries.description: The warrior will gain 100% increased critical strike chance and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.

entries.name: Slam
entries.description: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 87.

entries.name: Whirlwind
entries.description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.

entries.name: Bloodrage
entries.description: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

entries.name: Concussion Blow
entries.description: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

entries.name: Defensive Stance
entries.description: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases all threat generated by 80%.

entries.name: Disarm
entries.description: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries.description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

entries.name: Revenge
entries.description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 138 to 168 plus 25% of your Attack Power damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries.description: Bashes the target with your shield for 45 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

entries.name: Shield Block
entries.description: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

entries.name: Shield Slam
entries.description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 640 to 670 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

entries.name: Shield Wall
entries.description: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

entries.name: Sunder Armor
entries.description: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 450 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Taunt
entries.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

entries.name: Armor Proficiency
entries.description: You are proficient in the use of the following armor types: Cloth, Leather, Mail, Plate Mail.

entries.name: Languages
entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Blessing of Wisdom
entries.description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 40 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Cleanse
entries.description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.

entries.name: Consecration
entries.description: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 96 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 216 damage over 8 sec.

entries.name: Divine Favor
entries.description: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

entries.name: Exorcism
entries.description: Causes 475 to 529 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.

entries.name: Flash of Light
entries.description: Heals a friendly target for 291 to 325.

entries.name: Greater Blessing of Wisdom
entries.description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 40 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Hammer of Wrath
entries.description: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 474 to 522 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

entries.name: Holy Light
entries.description: Heals a friendly target for 1,495 to 1,665.

entries.name: Holy Shock
entries.description: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 334 to 362 Holy damage to an enemy, or 307 to 333 healing to an ally.

entries.name: Holy Wrath
entries.description: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 490 to 576 Holy damage to all Undead and Demon targets within 20 yds and stunning them for 2 sec.

entries.name: Lay on Hands
entries.description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 550 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration.

entries.name: Light's Vigil
entries.description: Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for 684 to 724. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party.

entries.name: Oath of Light
entries.description: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for 5 min, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to 400, your Flash of Light by up to 115, and your Holy Shock by up to 230. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by the Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Purify
entries.description: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

entries.name: Redemption
entries.description: Brings a dead player back to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

entries.name: Seal of Light
entries.description:
Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 94. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 61. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

entries.name: Seal of Righteousness
entries.description:
Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 22 to 75 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 170 to 186 Holy damage to an enemy.

entries.name: Seal of Wisdom
entries.description:
Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 90 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 59 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

entries.name: Sense Undead
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

entries.name: Turn Undead
entries.description: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.

entries.name: Blessing of Freedom
entries.description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Blessing of Kings
entries.description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Blessing of Protection
entries.description: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 10 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

entries.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
entries.description: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 55 damage taken per hit to the caster. Lasts 30 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Concentration Aura
entries.description: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Devotion Aura
entries.description: Gives 735 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Divine Intervention
entries.description: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.

entries.name: Divine Protection
entries.description: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

entries.name: Divine Shield
entries.description: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

entries.name: Fire Resistance Aura
entries.description: Gives 60 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Frost Resistance Aura
entries.description: Gives 60 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Greater Blessing of Kings
entries.description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Hammer of Justice
entries.description: Stuns the target for 6 sec.

entries.name: Holy Shield
entries.description: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 221 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

entries.name: Righteous Fury
entries.description: Increases all threat generated by 33%, and all threat generated by your Holy attacks by an additional 90%. Lasts 30 min.

entries.name: Seal of Fury
entries.description:
Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 35 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 153 to 167 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec.

entries.name: Seal of Justice
entries.description:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

entries.name: Shadow Resistance Aura
entries.description: Gives 60 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Swift Judgement
entries.description: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. Does not share a cooldown with your Judgement ability.

entries.name: Templar's Bulwark
entries.description: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

entries.name: Blessing of Might
entries.description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 133 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Greater Blessing of Might
entries.description: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 133 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Holy Strike
entries.description: An instant strike that causes 50% weapon damage plus an additional 40 to 53 as Holy damage.

entries.name: Judgement
entries.description: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.

entries.name: Repentance
entries.description: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

entries.name: Retribution Aura
entries.description: Causes 20 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

entries.name: Seal of Command
entries.description:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 169 to 187 Holy damage, 339 to 373 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

entries.name: Seal of the Crusader
entries.description:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 325 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 161. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Aspect of the Beast
entries.description: You take on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 110. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

entries.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
entries.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

entries.name: Aspect of the Hawk
entries.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 120. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

entries.name: Aspect of the Monkey
entries.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

entries.name: Aspect of the Pack
entries.description: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

entries.name: Aspect of the Wild
entries.description: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 60. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

entries.name: Beast Lore
entries.description: Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.

entries.name: Bestial Wrath
entries.description: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

entries.name: Call Pet
entries.description: Summons your pet to you.

entries.name: Dismiss Pet
entries.description: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.

entries.name: Eagle Eye
entries.description: Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.

entries.name: Eyes of the Beast
entries.description: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.

entries.name: Feed Pet
entries.description: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.

entries.name: Intimidation
entries.description: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

entries.name: Mend Pet
entries.description: Heals your pet 245 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.

entries.name: Revive Pet
entries.description: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

entries.name: Scare Beast
entries.description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.

entries.name: Summon Hawk
entries.description: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 108 plus 5% of your Ranged Attack Power Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

entries.name: Tame Beast
entries.description: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

entries.name: Tranquilizing Shot
entries.description: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.

entries.name: Aimed Shot
entries.description: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 350. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.

entries.name: Arcane Shot
entries.description: An instant shot that causes 280 Arcane damage.

entries.name: Auto Shot
entries.description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

entries.name: Concussive Shot
entries.description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

entries.name: Distracting Shot
entries.description: Distract the target, causing threat. More effective than Distracting Shot (Rank 5).

entries.name: Enchanted Flare
entries.description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area, and staves off magical darkness for 30 sec.

entries.name: Flare
entries.description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.

entries.name: Hunter's Mark
entries.description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 143. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.

entries.name: Multi-Shot
entries.description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.

entries.name: Rapid Fire
entries.description: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Scatter Shot
entries.description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

entries.name: Scorpid Sting
entries.description: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Serpent Sting
entries.description: Stings the target, causing 675 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Sniper Shot
entries.description: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 590 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

entries.name: Trueshot Aura
entries.description: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yards by 100. Lasts 30 min.

entries.name: Viper Sting
entries.description: Stings the target, draining 1,108 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Volley
entries.description: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 112 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.

entries.name: Counterattack
entries.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 55 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

entries.name: Deterrence
entries.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

entries.name: Disengage
entries.description: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. More effective than Disengage (Rank 2). Disables auto-attack.

entries.name: Explosive Trap
entries.description: Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 208 to 264 Fire damage and 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

entries.name: Feign Death
entries.description: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min. If not cancelled, after 6 min you will actually die.

entries.name: Freezing Trap
entries.description: Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

entries.name: Frost Trap
entries.description: Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

entries.name: Immolation Trap
entries.description: Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

entries.name: Lacerate
entries.description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 406 damage over 21 sec.

entries.name: Mongoose Bite
entries.description: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 57. Can only be performed after you dodge.

entries.name: Raptor Strike
entries.description: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 70.

entries.name: Strider Kick
entries.description: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

entries.name: Track Beasts
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

entries.name: Track Demons
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

entries.name: Track Dragonkin
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

entries.name: Track Elementals
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

entries.name: Track Giants
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

entries.name: Track Hidden
entries.description: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

entries.name: Track Humanoids
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

entries.name: Track Undead
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

entries.name: Wing Clip

entries.name: Arcane Resistance

entries.name: Bite

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Claw the enemy, causing 43 to 59 damage.

entries.name: Cower
entries.description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

entries.name: Dash
entries.description: Increases movement speed by 80% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Demoralizing Screech
entries.description: Blasts a single enemy for 24 to 42 damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 204 for 30 sec.

entries.name: Dismember
entries.description: Viciously bites enemy appendages for 50 to 58 damage and reduces the effectiveness of any healing by 25% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Dive
entries.description: Increases movement speed by 80% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Dust Cloud
entries.description: Your tallstrider kicks up an abrasive cloud of dust, reducing the target's Armor by 505 for 30 sec.

entries.name: Fire Resistance
entries.description: Increases Fire resistance by 120.

entries.name: Frost Resistance
entries.description: Increases Frost resistance by 120.

entries.name: Furious Howl
entries.description: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 15 yards by 83. Lasts 1 min.

entries.name: Great Stamina
entries.description: Stamina increased by 40.

entries.name: Growl
entries.description: Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.

entries.name: Lightning Breath
entries.description: Breathes lightning, instantly dealing 86 to 98 Nature damage to a single target.

entries.name: Mine!
entries.description: Grabs an enemy's weapon with its talons, causing 41 to 47 damage and disarming them for 3 sec.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries.description: Armor increased by 1,000.

entries.name: Nature Resistance
entries.description: Increases Nature resistance by 120.

entries.name: Pinch
entries.description: Pinches an enemy's legs for 88 to 102 damage and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

entries.name: Prowl
entries.description: Puts your pet in stealth mode, but slows its movement speed by 40%. The first attack from stealth receives a 50% bonus to damage. Lasts until cancelled.

entries.name: Savage Rend
entries.description: Slash an enemy with razor talons, causing the target to Bleed for 156 damage over 18 sec.

entries.name: Scorpid Poison
entries.description: Inflicts 25 Nature damage over 10 sec. Effect can stack up to 5 times on a single target.

entries.name: Shadow Resistance
entries.description: Increases Shadow resistance by 120.

entries.name: Shell Shield
entries.description: Reduces all damage your pet takes by 50% and increases the time between your pet's attacks by 60%, but deals more damage with each attack. Lasts 12 sec.

entries.name: Sonic Blast
entries.description: Emits a piercing shriek, inflicting 77 to 91 Nature damage and increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 20 sec.

entries.name: Swipe
entries.description: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 20 to 22 damage.

entries.name: Tendon Rip
entries.description: Tears at an enemy's legs for 60 damage over 9 sec and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

entries.name: Thunderstomp
entries.description: Shakes the ground with thundering force, doing 122 to 142 Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

entries.name: Trickster's Dance
entries.description: Increases your pet's chance to Dodge by 50% and decreases the time between your pet's attacks by 30% for 12 sec.

entries.name: Web
entries.description: Entangles an enemy in a corrosive web, immobilizing them and dealing 52 Nature damage over 4 sec.

entries.name: Pick Lock
entries.description: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

entries.name: Throw
entries.description: Hurl a thrown weapon at the target.

entries.name: Dual Wield
entries.description: Allows one-hand and off-hand weapons to be equipped in the off-hand.

entries.name: Armor Proficiency
entries.description: You are proficient in the use of the following armor types: Cloth, Leather.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.description: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.

entries.name: Parry
entries.description: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

entries.name: Languages
entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Ambush
entries.description: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 290 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

entries.name: Cheap Shot
entries.description: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

entries.name: Cold Blood
entries.description: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

entries.name: Eviscerate
entries.description:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power:
 1 point : 224-332 damage
 2 points: 394-502 damage
 3 points: 564-672 damage
 4 points: 734-842 damage
 5 points: 904-1,012 damage

entries.name: Expose Armor
entries.description:
Finishing move that exposes the target for 30 sec, reducing Armor per combo point:
 1 point : 450 Armor
 2 points: 900 Armor
 3 points: 1,350 Armor
 4 points: 1,800 Armor
 5 points: 2,250 Armor

entries.name: Garrote
entries.description: Garrote the enemy, causing 552 damage over 18 sec, increased by your Attack Power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

entries.name: Kidney Shot
entries.description:
Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 2 seconds
 2 points: 3 seconds
 3 points: 4 seconds
 4 points: 5 seconds
 5 points: 6 seconds

entries.name: Mutilate
entries.description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 71 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

entries.name: Rupture
entries.description:
Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 159 damage over 8 secs
 2 points: 222 damage over 10 secs
 3 points: 295 damage over 12 secs
 4 points: 377 damage over 14 secs
 5 points: 469 damage over 16 secs

entries.name: Slice and Dice
entries.description:
Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 30%. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 9 seconds
 2 points: 12 seconds
 3 points: 15 seconds
 4 points: 18 seconds
 5 points: 21 seconds

entries.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Backstab
entries.description: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 225 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

entries.name: Blade Flurry
entries.description: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.description: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Feint
entries.description: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

entries.name: Gouge
entries.description: Causes 75 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. The target must be facing you. Any damage taken will break the effect. Awards 1 combo point.

entries.name: Kick
entries.description: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 80 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

entries.name: Shank
entries.description: Instantly strike with your off-hand weapon, dealing 50% weapon damage and generating 25 Energy. Shank cannot Miss.

entries.name: Sinister Strike
entries.description: An instant strike that causes 68 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.

entries.name: Sprint
entries.description: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 70% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

entries.name: Blind
entries.description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

entries.name: Death Mark
entries.description:
Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance:
 1 point : 12% stored, 401 damage cap
 2 points: 24% stored, 646 damage cap
 3 points: 36% stored, 891 damage cap
 4 points: 48% stored, 1136 damage cap
 5 points: 60% stored, 1381 damage cap

entries.name: Detect Traps
entries.description: Greatly increased chance to detect traps.

entries.name: Disarm Trap
entries.description: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it. Don't get too close or the trap will go off.

entries.name: Distract
entries.description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.

entries.name: Ghostly Strike
entries.description: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.

entries.name: Hemorrhage
entries.description: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

entries.name: Pick Pocket
entries.description: Pick the target's pocket.

entries.name: Poised
entries.description: While at maximum Energy, and out of combat, reduce the Energy cost of your next ability by 10.

entries.name: Premeditation
entries.description: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

entries.name: Preparation
entries.description: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

entries.name: Safe Fall
entries.description: Reduces damage from falling.

entries.name: Sap
entries.description: Incapacitates the target for up to 45 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.description: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

entries.name: Vanish
entries.description: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects. More effective than Vanish (Rank 1).

entries.name: Crippling Poison
entries.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, slowing their movement speed by 70% for 12 sec.

entries.name: Instant Poison
entries.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 20% chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts 76 to 100 Nature damage. 250 charges.

entries.name: Mind-numbing Poison
entries.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 20% chance of poisoning the enemy, increasing their casting time by 60% for 14 sec. 225 charges.

entries.name: Deadly Poison
entries.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy for 92 Nature damage over 12 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target. 240 charges.

entries.name: Wound Poison
entries.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing all healing effects used on them by 165 for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target. 240 charges.

entries.name: Blinding Powder
entries.description: Create the reagent for the Blind ability.

entries.name: Shoot
entries.description: Attack with an equipped wand.

entries.name: Armor Proficiency
entries.description: You are proficient in the use of the following armor types: Cloth.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.description: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.

entries.name: Languages
entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Confounding Flash
entries.description: Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.

entries.name: Contingency Plan
entries.description: Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 926 damage and begin healing for 670 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.

entries.name: Dispel Magic
entries.description: Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.

entries.name: Divine Spirit
entries.description: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

entries.name: Elune's Grace
entries.description: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.

entries.name: Feedback
entries.description: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Inner Fire
entries.description: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1,395. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.

entries.name: Inner Focus
entries.description: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

entries.name: Levitate
entries.description: Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Mounting or any damage taken will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.

entries.name: Mana Burn
entries.description: Drains 746 to 788 mana from a target. For each mana drained in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

entries.name: Penance
entries.description: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 92 Holy damage to an enemy, or 425 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

entries.name: Power Infusion
entries.description: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Power Word: Fortitude
entries.description: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

entries.name: Power Word: Shield
entries.description: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 928 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

entries.name: Prayer of Fortitude
entries.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

entries.name: Prayer of Spirit
entries.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

entries.name: Shackle Undead
entries.description: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

entries.name: Starshards
entries.description: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1,800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.

entries.name: Abolish Disease
entries.description: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 5 seconds for 20 sec.

entries.name: Chastise
entries.description: Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat.

entries.name: Cure Disease
entries.description: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

entries.name: Desperate Prayer
entries.description: Instantly heals the caster for 1,285 to 1,513.

entries.name: Divine Grace
entries.description: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1,285 to 1,513 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.

entries.name: Fear Ward
entries.description: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 3 min.

entries.name: Flash Heal
entries.description: Heals a friendly target for 773 to 909.

entries.name: Greater Heal
entries.description: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 1,853 to 2,067.

entries.name: Heal
entries.description: Heal your target for 633 to 713.

entries.name: Holy Fire
entries.description: Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 184 to 232 Holy damage and an additional 75 Holy damage over 10 sec.

entries.name: Holy Nova
entries.description:
Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 174 to 200 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 288 to 334. These effects cause no threat.

Each time Holy Fire deals damage, you have a 5% chance for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

entries.name: Lesser Heal
entries.description: Heal your target for 157 to 181.

entries.name: Prayer of Healing
entries.description: A powerful prayer that heals the target and their party for 631 to 667. Party members must be within 40 yards of target.

entries.name: Prayer of Mending
entries.description: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 413 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yds. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

entries.name: Renew
entries.description: Heals the target of 830 damage over 15 sec.

entries.name: Resurrection
entries.description: Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

entries.name: Smite
entries.description: Smite an enemy for 166 to 186 Holy damage.

entries.name: Dark Sacrifice
entries.description: Cannibalize 1,600 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 1,600 Mana, plus your Spirit.

entries.name: Devouring Plague
entries.description: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 848 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

entries.name: Fade
entries.description: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec. More effective than Fade (rank 5).

entries.name: Hex of Weakness
entries.description: Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min

entries.name: Mind Blast
entries.description: Blasts the target for 477 to 503 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.

entries.name: Mind Control
entries.description: Controls a humanoid mind up to level 64, but increases the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 1 min.

entries.name: Mind Flay
entries.description: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 390 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

entries.name: Mind Soothe
entries.description: Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Mind Vision
entries.description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

entries.name: Prayer of Shadow Protection
entries.description: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 20 min.

entries.name: Psychic Scream
entries.description: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

entries.name: Shadow Protection
entries.description: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 60 for 10 min.

entries.name: Shadow Word: Death
entries.description: A word of dark binding that inflicts 444 to 472 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 30% of your maximum health.

entries.name: Shadow Word: Pain
entries.description: A word of darkness that causes 762 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

entries.name: Shadowform
entries.description: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

entries.name: Shadowguard
entries.description: The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 96 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.

entries.name: Silence
entries.description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

entries.name: Touch of Weakness
entries.description: The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 204 for 2 min.

entries.name: Vampiric Embrace
entries.description: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

entries.name: Armor Proficiency
entries.description: You are proficient in the use of the following armor types: Cloth, Leather, Mail.

entries.name: Block
entries.description: Gives a chance to block enemy melee and ranged attacks.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.description: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.

entries.name: Languages
entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Call of the Ancestors
entries.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.

entries.name: Call of the Elements
entries.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

entries.name: Call of the Spirits
entries.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.description: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 495 to 551 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

entries.name: Earth Shock
entries.description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 517 to 545 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

entries.name: Earthbind Totem
entries.description: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.

entries.name: Fire Nova
entries.description: Instantly inflicts 232 to 258 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.

entries.name: Flame Shock
entries.description: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 292 Fire damage immediately and 320 Fire damage over 12 sec.

entries.name: Frost Shock
entries.description: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 495 to 523 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries.description: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 342 to 380 Nature damage.

entries.name: Lightning Mastery
entries.description: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Magma Totem
entries.description: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 73 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

entries.name: Purge
entries.description: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.

entries.name: Searing Totem
entries.description: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 55 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 40 to 54 Fire damage.

entries.name: Stoneclaw Totem
entries.description: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 486 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.

entries.name: Totemic Recall
entries.description: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.

entries.name: Astral Recall
entries.description: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to home. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

entries.name: Far Sight
entries.description: Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.

entries.name: Fire Resistance Totem
entries.description: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party or raid members within 30 yards by 60.

entries.name: Flametongue Totem
entries.description: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit causes 17 to 55 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Flametongue Weapon
entries.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 35 to 112 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Flametongue Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.

entries.name: Frost Resistance Totem
entries.description: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min. The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 60, if within 30 yards.

entries.name: Frostbrand Weapon
entries.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 169 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 60 minutes.

entries.name: Ghost Wolf
entries.description: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

entries.name: Grace of Air Totem
entries.description: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party or raid members within 30 yards by 89. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Grounding Totem
entries.description: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.

entries.name: Lightning Shield
entries.description: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 178 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

entries.name: Nature Resistance Totem
entries.description: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 60.

entries.name: Rage of the Farseer
entries.description: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

entries.name: Rockbiter Weapon
entries.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 653 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.

entries.name: Sentry Totem
entries.description: Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and Shaman sight.

entries.name: Stoneskin Totem
entries.description: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 30. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Stormstrike
entries.description: Instantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

entries.name: Strength of Earth Totem
entries.description: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 53. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Totemic Call
entries.description: Relocates your active totems to your location.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

entries.name: Water Walking
entries.description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.

entries.name: Windfury Totem
entries.description: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 246 extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Windfury Weapon
entries.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 333 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.

entries.name: Windwall Totem
entries.description: Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 64. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Ancestral Spirit
entries.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

entries.name: Chain Heal
entries.description: Heals the friendly target for 474 to 538, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.

entries.name: Cure Disease
entries.description: Cures 1 disease on the target.

entries.name: Cure Poison
entries.description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

entries.name: Disease Cleansing Totem
entries.description: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Healing Stream Totem
entries.description: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 11 every 2 seconds.

entries.name: Healing Wave
entries.description: Heals a friendly target for 1,508 to 1,722.

entries.name: Lesser Healing Wave
entries.description: Heals a friendly target for 775 to 865.

entries.name: Mana Spring Totem
entries.description: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 10 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

entries.name: Mana Tide Totem
entries.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 290 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

entries.name: Nature's Swiftness
entries.description: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

entries.name: Poison Cleansing Totem
entries.description: Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Reincarnation
entries.description: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.

entries.name: Riptide
entries.description: Heals a friendly target for 805 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

entries.name: Tremor Totem
entries.description: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 5 min.

entries.name: Water Shield
entries.description:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

entries.name: Shoot
entries.description: Attack with an equipped wand.

entries.name: Comprehend Scroll
entries.description: Decipher an untranslated scroll.

entries.name: Armor Proficiency
entries.description: You are proficient in the use of the following armor types: Cloth.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.description: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.

entries.name: Languages
entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Amplify Magic
entries.description: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 113 and healing spells by up to 225. Lasts 10 min.

entries.name: Arcane Blast
entries.description: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 218 to 254 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.

entries.name: Arcane Brilliance
entries.description: Infuses the target's party and raid with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

entries.name: Arcane Explosion
entries.description: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 238 to 258 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

entries.name: Arcane Intellect
entries.description: Increases the target's Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

entries.name: Arcane Missiles
entries.description: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 209 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.

entries.name: Arcane Power
entries.description: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

entries.name: Arcane Wrath
entries.description: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 406 to 496 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.

entries.name: Blink
entries.description: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from Stuns and Immobilizes.

entries.name: Conjure Food
entries.description:
Conjures 10 cinnamon rolls, providing the mage and his allies with something to eat.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Conjure Mana Agate
entries.description:
Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 375 to 425 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Conjure Mana Citrine
entries.description:
Conjures a mana citrine that can be used to instantly restore 775 to 925 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Conjure Mana Jade
entries.description:
Conjures a mana jade that can be used to instantly restore 550 to 650 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Conjure Mana Ruby
entries.description:
Conjures a mana ruby that can be used to instantly restore 1,000 to 1,200 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Conjure Water
entries.description:
Conjures 10 bottles of crystal water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Counterspell
entries.description: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.

entries.name: Dampen Magic
entries.description: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to 135 and healing spells by up to 270. Lasts 10 min.

entries.name: Evocation
entries.description: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1,500%. Lasts 8 sec.

entries.name: Mage Armor
entries.description: Increases your resistance to all magic by 15 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

entries.name: Mana Shield
entries.description: Absorbs 570 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.

entries.name: Polymorph
entries.description: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

entries.name: Portal: Darnassus
entries.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Darnassus.

entries.name: Portal: Ironforge
entries.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Ironforge.

entries.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Orgrimmar.

entries.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Thunder Bluff.

entries.name: Portal: Undercity
entries.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Undercity.

entries.name: Presence of Mind
entries.description: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

entries.name: Remove Lesser Curse
entries.description: Removes 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

entries.name: Slow Fall
entries.description: Slows falling speed for 30 sec.

entries.name: Teleport: Dalaran
entries.description: Teleports the caster to Dalaran.

entries.name: Teleport: Darnassus
entries.description: Teleports the caster to Darnassus.

entries.name: Teleport: Ironforge
entries.description: Teleports the caster to Ironforge.

entries.name: Teleport: Orgrimmar
entries.description: Teleports the caster to Orgrimmar.

entries.name: Teleport: Stormwind
entries.description: Teleports the caster to Stormwind.

entries.name: Teleport: Thunder Bluff
entries.description: Teleports the caster to Thunder Bluff.

entries.name: Teleport: Undercity
entries.description: Teleports the caster to Undercity.

entries.name: Blast Wave
entries.description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 453 to 533 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

entries.name: Combustion
entries.description: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

entries.name: Fire Blast
entries.description: Blasts the enemy for 417 to 489 Fire damage.

entries.name: Fire Ward
entries.description: Absorbs 913 Fire damage. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Fireball
entries.description: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 425 to 541 Fire damage and an additional 60 Fire damage over 8 sec.

entries.name: Flamestrike
entries.description: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 381 to 465 Fire damage and an additional 332 Fire damage over 8 sec. Only one Flamestrike can be active per Mage at a time.

entries.name: Frostfire Bolt
entries.description: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 270 to 314 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 57 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists and counts as both Frost and Fire damage.

entries.name: Pyroblast
entries.description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 520 to 646 Fire damage and an additional 212 Fire damage over 12 sec.

entries.name: Scorch
entries.description: Scorch the enemy for 166 to 196 Fire damage.

entries.name: Blizzard
entries.description: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 1,168 Frost damage over 8 sec.

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.description: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

entries.name: Cone of Cold
entries.description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 260 to 286 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec. The first 4 targets hit by this cone are slowed by an additional 10% for an additional 3 sec.

entries.name: Frost Armor
entries.description: Increases Armor by 200. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

entries.name: Frost Nova
entries.description: Blasts enemies near the caster for 71 to 79 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

entries.name: Frost Ward
entries.description: Absorbs 913 Frost damage. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Frostbolt
entries.description: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 457 to 493 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 9 sec.

entries.name: Ice Armor
entries.description: Increases Armor by 560 and frost resistance by 15. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

entries.name: Ice Barrier
entries.description: Shield yourself, absorbing 819 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.

entries.name: Ice Block
entries.description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

entries.name: Ice Lance
entries.description: Deals 136 to 160 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.
