entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Amplify Curse
entries.description: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Bane of Agony
entries.description: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 552 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Bane of Doom
entries.description: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1,742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Corruption
entries.description: Corrupts the target, causing 438 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

entries.name: Curse of Exhaustion
entries.description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Curse of Recklessness
entries.description: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 505 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Curse of the Elements
entries.description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 75 and increasing Magic damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Curse of Tongues
entries.description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Curse of Weakness
entries.description: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 37 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Death Coil
entries.description: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 460 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

entries.name: Drain Life
entries.description: Transfers 51 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

entries.name: Drain Mana
entries.description: Transfers 139 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

entries.name: Drain Soul
entries.description: Drains the soul of the target, causing 420 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

entries.name: Fear
entries.description: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

entries.name: Howl of Terror
entries.description: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

entries.name: Life Tap
entries.description: Converts 424 Health into 424 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted.

entries.name: Siphon Life
entries.description: Transfers 41 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Wrack
entries.description: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 86 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Banish
entries.description: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

entries.name: Create Firestone
entries.description:
Creates a Major Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 2% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Create Healthstone
entries.description:
Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1,440 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Create Soulstone
entries.description:
Creates a Major Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 2,200 health and 2800 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Create Spellstone
entries.description:
Creates a Major Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 2% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

entries.name: Demon Armor
entries.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 570, Shadow resistance by 15 and increases health regeneration by 15 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

entries.name: Demon Skin
entries.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and increases health regeneration by 5 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

entries.name: Demonic Sacrifice
entries.description:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

entries.name: Detect Invisibility
entries.description: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.

entries.name: Eye of Kilrogg
entries.description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.

entries.name: Fel Domination
entries.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

entries.name: Health Funnel
entries.description: Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.

entries.name: Inferno
entries.description: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

entries.name: Ritual of Doom
entries.description: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

entries.name: Ritual of Summoning
entries.description: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

entries.name: Sense Demons
entries.description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

entries.name: Shadow Ward
entries.description: Absorbs 920 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Soul Link
entries.description: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

entries.name: Subjugate Demon
entries.description: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 64, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.

entries.name: Summon Felhunter
entries.description: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

entries.name: Summon Imp
entries.description: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

entries.name: Summon Incubus
entries.description: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

entries.name: Summon Succubus
entries.description: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

entries.name: Summon Voidwalker
entries.description: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

entries.name: Unending Breath
entries.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

entries.name: Bane of Havoc
entries.description: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Conflagrate
entries.description: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 251 to 313 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

entries.name: Hellfire
entries.description: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 210 Fire damage to himself and 210 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Immolate
entries.description: Burns the enemy for 158 Fire damage and then an additional 275 Fire damage over 15 sec.

entries.name: Incinerate
entries.description: Deals 201 to 233 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

entries.name: Rain of Fire
entries.description: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 884 Fire damage over 8 sec.

entries.name: Searing Pain
entries.description: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 107 to 125 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

entries.name: Shadow Bolt
entries.description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 253 to 283 Shadow damage.

entries.name: Shadowburn
entries.description: Instantly blasts the target for 258 to 288 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 8 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

entries.name: Soul Fire
entries.description: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 390 to 486 Fire damage.

entries.name: Blood Pact
entries.description: Increases party members' Stamina by 54.

entries.name: Consume Shadows
entries.description: The Voidwalker consumes nearby shadows to bolster its form, recovering 1,940 health over 10 sec. Cannot be used while in combat.

entries.name: Devour Magic
entries.description: Purges 1 harmful magic effect from a friend or 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy. If an effect is devoured, the Felhunter will be healed for 618.

entries.name: Fire Shield
entries.description: Surrounds the target in a shield of fire. Every strike against the target causes 13 Fire damage to the attacker. Lasts 3 min. Your pet cannot cast Fire Shield on itself.

entries.name: Firebolt
entries.description: Deals 43 to 47 Fire damage to a target.

entries.name: Lash of Pain
entries.description: An instant attack that lashes the target, causing 50 Shadow damage.

entries.name: Lesser Invisibility
entries.description: Gives your summoned demon Lesser Invisibility for up to 5 min. This spell can only be used out of combat.

entries.name: Paranoia
entries.description: Increases the stealth detection of all party members within 30 yds of the Felhunter as if they were 6 levels higher.

entries.name: Phase Shift
entries.description: Shifts the imp out of phase with the world, making it unattackable unless it attacks.

entries.name: Sacrifice
entries.description: Sacrifices the Voidwalker, giving its owner a shield that will absorb 1,930 damage for 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage.

entries.name: Seduction
entries.description: Seduces the target, preventing all actions for up to 15 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Only works against Humanoids.

entries.name: Soothing Kiss
entries.description: Soothes the target, increasing the chance that it will attack something else. More effective than Soothing Kiss (Rank 3).

entries.name: Spell Lock
entries.description: Silences the enemy for 3 sec. If used on a casting target, it will counter the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 8 sec.

entries.name: Suffering
entries.description: Taunts all enemies within 10 yards, increasing the chance that they will attack the Voidwalker. More effective than Suffering (Rank 3).

entries.name: Tainted Blood
entries.description: Taints the Felhunter's blood for 1 min. When the Felhunter is hit with a melee attack, the attacker will lose 40 melee attack power for 10 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.

entries.name: Torment
entries.description: Taunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker. More effective than Torment (Rank 5).

entries.name: Armor Proficiency
entries.description: You are proficient in the use of the following armor types: Cloth, Leather.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.description: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.

entries.name: Languages
entries.description: You are fluent in the following languages:

entries.name: Barkskin
entries.description: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Entangling Roots
entries.description: Roots the target in place and causes 234 Nature damage over 27 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. You may only have 1 target Rooted at a time.

entries.name: Faerie Fire
entries.description: Decrease the armor of the target by 505 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

entries.name: Hibernate
entries.description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

entries.name: Hurricane
entries.description: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 132 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

entries.name: Insect Swarm
entries.description: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 186 Nature damage over 12 sec.

entries.name: Moonfire
entries.description: Burns the enemy for 128 to 150 Arcane damage and then an additional 240 Arcane damage over 12 sec.

entries.name: Moonkin Form
entries.description:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

entries.name: Nature's Grasp
entries.description: The next 1 melee attack that strikes the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 6). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.

entries.name: Omen of Clarity
entries.description: Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources.

entries.name: Soothe Animal
entries.description: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Beast targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Starfire
entries.description: Causes 490 to 576 Arcane damage to the target.

entries.name: Teleport: Moonglade
entries.description: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

entries.name: Thorns
entries.description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 18 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

entries.name: Wrath
entries.description: Causes 92 to 102 Nature damage to the target.

entries.name: Aquatic Form
entries.description:
Shapeshift into Aquatic Form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

entries.name: Bash
entries.description: Stuns the target for 4 sec.

entries.name: Bear Form
entries.description:
Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 120, Armor contribution from items by 180%, and Health by 180. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

entries.name: Cat Form
entries.description:
Shapeshift into Cat Form, increasing Attack Power by 120 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

entries.name: Challenging Roar
entries.description: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Claw the enemy for 140% normal damage plus 161. Awards 1 combo point.

entries.name: Cower
entries.description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

entries.name: Dash
entries.description: Increases movement speed by 60% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

entries.name: Demoralizing Roar
entries.description: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 204. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Dire Bear Form
entries.description:
Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 180, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 1,240. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

entries.name: Enrage
entries.description: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

entries.name: Feline Grace
entries.description: Reduces damage from falling.

entries.name: Feral Charge
entries.description:
Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.

Feral Charge (Cat): 8-25 yd range, Instant, 30 sec cooldown, Requires Cat Form. Leap behind an enemy.

entries.name: Ferocious Bite
entries.description:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 3.3 additional damage. Damage is increased by your Attack Power.
 1 point : 245-321 damage
 2 points: 426-502 damage
 3 points: 607-683 damage
 4 points: 788-864 damage
 5 points: 969-1045 damage

entries.name: Frenzied Regeneration
entries.description: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

entries.name: Growl
entries.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

entries.name: Lacerate
entries.description: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 75 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

entries.name: Maul
entries.description: Increases the druid's next attack by 128 damage.

entries.name: Poised
entries.description: While at maximum Energy, and out of combat, reduce the Energy cost of your next ability by 10.

entries.name: Pounce
